origin: https://pypi.org/project/networkx/ (the official pure-Python wheels, py3-none-any, unmodified)
note: Imported straight from the wheel (zipimport) by py/network.py, run as python -I -S so nothing installed on the machine is used and no numpy or scipy is needed. The newest wheel the found Python supports is used: 3.7 needs Python 3.12 or later (not 3.14.1); 3.2.1 covers Python 3.9 to 3.11, such as macOS's own /usr/bin/python3. See LICENCE-NOTICE.md.
